rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act or facility of overdrawing a bank account.

example.english: I have an overdraft on my bank account this month; I’ll clear it when I get paid.

rows.note: Use this for the specific amount that has been overdrawn, especially when stating a figure.

example.english: My statement shows that my overdraft amount this month is three thousand dollars.

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the maximum amount the bank allows you to overdraw.

example.english: The bank raised my account’s overdraft limit to twenty thousand dollars.
